_about: Joseph Glanvill (1636-1680), Royal Society apologist and sceptic: Essays on Several Important Subjects in Philosophy and Religion (London: J. D. for John Baker and Henry Mortlock, 1676; imprimatur 27 March 1675; the OCR reads the year as i6j6), and Scepsis Scientifica, or Confest Ignorance the way to Science, edited with an introductory essay by John Owen (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, 1885), raw IA OCR.
